title: 彭博智库：AI是工具非意识，AGI遥不可及
speaker: Robert Lee

segments.en: And also there are, you know, a few snake oil salesmen out there who were looking to boost stock prices or boost valuations they had a fund raising. I don't want to be too cynical but that is very, there's a lot of truth in that at the moment.
segments.zh: 还有一些人为了抬高估值或融资而夸大宣传。我不想太愤世嫉俗，但这确实存在。

segments.en: So yeah, AI adds value, it's a great productivity tool, it's a great efficiency tool. Is there any evidence that it's sent to you in any way, none whatsoever?
segments.zh: AI确实有价值，是很好的生产力和效率工具。但有任何证据表明它有意识吗？完全没有。

segments.en: I would say is there any consciousness there, no way? Is AGI or artificial general intelligence, in other words, AI with a human light level of intelligence, anywhere close to being on the shelves, you know, we're still in the development phases.
segments.zh: 有意识吗？没有。AGI，即达到人类水平的AI，离落地还很远，我们仍处于发展阶段。

segments.en: So and if you look at the weight of academic opinion and I would encourage people to look at that, you know, the academics don't see it coming at this point, it remains a long term objective for the industry.
segments.zh: 如果你看看学术界的观点，我鼓励大家去了解，目前学者们并不认为AGI会很快到来，它仍是行业的长期目标。
